banish.label: Pack holds a Scroll of Banishment
banish.explanation: A level-26 Mage with an empty home carries a Scroll of Banishment, a Scroll of Word of Recall, a ration and a spell book. The production home-store routine decides what to put in the home. Original: the home score gives a Banishment scroll nothing, so the Borg leaves it in the pack. Corrected: the scroll is worth the same as other stocked scrolls and the Borg offers it to the home.
